info.title: Nahhasio local client API
info.description: Database-backed viewer and administrator sessions, self-service profiles and bounded catalog operations. Native clients retain bearer secrets; restricted family policies fail closed until filtered catalogs are implemented.

get.description: Read-only public releases using actual installment/episode dates only. Defaults to the database current year. Year/month are valid only in year scope. Optional day (1–31) requires year scope and a supplied month. Days contain exact counts by recorded date from the filtered scope before pagination (including any day filter), ordered by date; undated returns no days. A month overview can use pageSize=1 without fetching all entries. Upcoming is dated-only from current_date across years. Undated includes announced installments and episodes whose parent is announced/airing. Episode status is the parent installment status; episodeCount is null for episodes. Posters prefer installment then work. Stable ascending date (null last), work sort title, installment/episode positions, kind and UUID ordering. Years are ascending distinct actual known public release years, independent of query filters. A passed date does not imply playback availability.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Calendar quarter, 1 winter through 4 autumn. Year scope only; mutually exclusive with month/day.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Day of month; requires year scope and a supplied month. Nonexistent calendar dates match no entries.

200.description: Bounded public releases page and server calendar date

400.description: Invalid query, unknown field or incompatible scope/year/month/day

Committed viewer state; other personal fields are preserved

patch.description: Manual override. Null installmentId targets the whole work; null episodeId targets all units of the installment. Bulk includes future units. Episode requires its season installment. Progress/duration/subtitle offset and existing state UUIDs are preserved.

200.description: Committed viewer state including future manual choices

404.description: Work or target not found in its parent

get.description: Published work comments/reviews by active discoverable authors, newest first with stable kind/UUID ties. Spoiler bodies are plain text and require UI reveal. Owner may read a private work. Fixed 20 entries per page.
Owner-only catalog. All filters combine with AND; genre matches its vocabulary slug. Text search matches title, Arabic title and aliases. Stable SQL pagination.

200.description: Registered artwork. Send Bearer authorization. URL is relative to the configured server.

Dated episodes released through today, newest first. Use kind=movies for movies only or kind=all for both. Legacy includeMovies=true selects both when kind is omitted. Visibility defaults to public; private/all require administrator permission. Account-scoped viewing filters, admin-only private inclusion, text search, and bounded pagination.
Bounded public family activity and anticipated installments, nearest known date first. Published comments/reviews from active discoverable accounts only.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Order complete groups before pagination; sort applies within each group.

200.description: Authenticated owner viewing API; bounded read-only result.
Authenticated owner viewing API; bounded read-only result.
Authenticated owner viewing API; bounded read-only result.

get.description: Session-authorized administrative work listing. Requires active administrator identity/account. Includes public/private and all editorial workflow states by default. Bound pagination, literal text/alias search, structure/workflow/visibility/missing-data filters and stable sorts. Rows and totals share a single SQL snapshot. Read-only; no private local-admin token or startup migrations.

Active administrator session required. Core title fields only; relationships, provider identities and owned data are preserved. Review is read-only and actor-bound, expires in 10 minutes; save checks the signed exact draft and revisions, locks all records, writes and audits atomically.
